persons_words.verbatim: 새로운 테스트는 HOOMD와 OpenFOAM을 함께 사용해보고싶어, / MD로 Oldroyd-B유체를 구현하고 여기서 Viscoelastic properties를 계산한 뒤, 이를 바탕으로 CFD 시뮬레이션을 진행한다. / Under a hub (Recommended) / λ, η_p, η_s (Recommended) / Channel start-up (Recommended) / Dumbbells, implicit solvent (Recommended) / rheoTool image (Recommended)
persons_words.gloss: For the new test, I would like to try HOOMD and OpenFOAM together. / Implement an Oldroyd-B fluid with MD, compute its viscoelastic properties from it, then run a CFD simulation on that basis. / Under a hub. / The relaxation time, the polymer viscosity and the solvent viscosity. / The start-up of a planar channel flow. / Hookean dumbbells in an implicit solvent. / The rheoTool image on this computer.

paragraph: An agent that controls rheoTool's solvers on OpenFOAM in words for the start-up of a planar channel flow of an Oldroyd-B fluid: it takes the relaxation time, the polymer viscosity and the solvent viscosity the MD agent handed over, once the person has let the card cross, holds any value its build did not declare, and, asked for a run, runs the start-up flow on the settings the person gives and reports the centreline velocity against time as the solver writes it, with the analytical solution computed by a library skill to compare against.
